Reproduced: `\<span title=a=b;a@b.cc>` and `\<a href=x?a=1&b=me@x.cc>` are stored escaped at main 1767c9af (or as a document the engine loads) and stored raw at 28ae264d (`<span title=a=b;[a@b.cc](mailto:a@b.cc)>`), and the engine gives no document (MilkdownError: Cannot create node for doc). The same block-start gap stores `\<a b=x=*y*>` raw on main too, so fix the class at block start.
